title: Progressive PRD: Compact Hosted Surface (chat + generation + embeddings + rerank) — acceptance matrix & staged rollout checklist
creator: Leah Chen
overview: Deliver a compact, opinionated hosted surface that exposes a single minimal API for common generation and similarity workflows (chat/completions + embeddings + rerank). This PRD defines behavioral contracts, quality gates, latency/cost SLOs, and a staged rollout checklist designed to minimize regressions for existing hosted users while enabling new composition patterns (embed -> rerank -> generate).
goals: Ship a slimline hosted API that supports chat, completions, embeddings, and reranking with a single consistent param surface
Provide deterministic fallback behavior and graded degradation when preferred model variants are unavailable
Keep p50 endpoint latency for chat/completions below 120ms token-start for small inputs on hosted tier; ensure embeddings p99 under 250ms for 512-d inputs
Enable a canary-style staged rollout controlled by traffic percentage and model lane to detect quality regressions early
non_goals: Not intended to replace Dedicated or Private full feature parity at launch
No multi-modal inputs (images/audio) in the initial compact surface
No per-request user-level KV caching controls in first cut
scope_description: The compact surface includes: a single route for text generation (chat/completions mode switch), a separate embeddings route, and a rerank helper that accepts candidate lists + embeddings. The surface standardizes parameter names (max_tokens, temperature, top_p, model_lane) and adds composition helpers for embed->rerank->generate orchestration. Operationally includes observability dashboards, canary controls by customer cohort, and rollout automation for graded fallback policies.
requirements: API contract: clear parameter mapping and backward-compatible defaults; support both legacy endpoint compatibility headers and the new compact route
Behavioral contracts: deterministic fallback to smaller model_lane variants when capacity constrained; explicit response metadata describing fallback reason
Performance SLOs: chat/completions p50 < 120ms (token-start) for warm models under 95th percentile traffic profile; embeddings p99 < 250ms for 512-d requests
Quality gates: automated eval harness includes 1k prompt/response pairs for generation and 500 labeled triplets for rerank baseline comparisons
Security and compliance: requests must respect customer KMS keys if present; audit events emitted for composition flows that touch customer data
Operational: metrics emitted for per-request cost estimate, token counts, model_lane used, and downgrade events
Docs/SDKs: minimal quickstart (JS/Python) with composition examples and migration guide from legacy endpoints
acceptance_criteria: API schema published and validated against OpenAPI/JSON Schema with backward-compatible header for legacy clients
End-to-end smoke tests: generation, embedding, rerank composition succeed with example datasets in staging
Quality regression: no statistically significant drop (>2% measured at 90% confidence) on generation eval suite compared to baseline model lane
Performance: staging runs meet SLO thresholds for p50/p95/p99 specified above in 95% of test windows
Operational readiness: dashboards (traffic by model_lane, fallback count, latency histograms) deployed and connected to alerting
Rollout controls: feature-flagged staged rollout mechanism integrated with console and CLI for traffic ramp and emergency rollback
Documentation: PRD linked to public quickstart and migration guide; SDK examples included in repo
Security: security review ticket closed and KMS integration verified end-to-end with test key
launch_checklist: Finalize API contract and publish OpenAPI spec
Merge SDK changes and publish pre-release packages
Run 3-day canary at 1% traffic with synthetic and real small-customer traffic
Evaluate canary metrics; run A/B quality comparisons with existing endpoints
Ramp to 5% then 20% if no critical alerts; hold and run extended evals at each step
Enable per-tenant opt-out for first 30 days post-launch
On-call runbook and rollback steps documented and validated in a dry-run
Run security smoke tests (KMS keys, audit logs) and confirm false-positive thresholds
Coordinate PR with marketing & support: release notes, migration guide, and customer FAQ
Final sign-off from PM, Eng lead, Design lead, and Security
test_plan: Unit + integration tests for parameter mapping and fallback semantics
Load tests simulating production percentiles with different model_lane mixes
Eval harness: generation BLEU/ROUGE-like metrics and human review sampling for 1k prompts
Rerank evaluation: NDCG@10 comparisons against baseline scores using labeled datasets
Chaos tests: simulated model node failures to validate graceful fallback and circuit-breaker behavior
Cross-compatibility tests: legacy client header switch and SDK migration paths
monitoring_and_alerting: Latency p50/p95/p99 per-route and per-model_lane in Console
Fallback rate > 1% sustained for 10m -> PAGE on-call
Quality regressions detected by eval harness automated daily job -> pager when >2% shift
Token-cost anomaly detection (sudden >30% increase per-req) -> Ops ticket created
Audit log delivery failures -> Security pager
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Unexpected quality regressions when routing to quantized or smaller model_lanes. Mitigation: conservative canary with banded traffic and human spot checks; auto-roll back on quality drift beyond threshold
Risk: Latency spikes during peak traffic. Mitigation: set conservative batching/caching defaults for hosted lane; increase burst capacity for early ramp
Risk: Customer confusion over new compact param names. Mitigation: migration guide, SDKs with compatibility shims, and deprecation timeline for legacy params
Risk: Security compliance gaps for composition flows. Mitigation: include audit event schema in release and run compliance runbook with security team
